description: Sends The Landing Company a request for a 30-minute call with Campion Fellin, with the person’s name, email, problem description, and optionally company and availability. It does not book a time: the reply comes by email within one business day.

availability.description: Days, times and time zone that suit them, if they said.

company.description: Their company or organization, if they gave one.

problem.description: A few sentences in the person’s words: what has been difficult, what they have tried, and what a good outcome looks like.

name: request_consultation
title: Request a call
